brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Depth metaphor reads instantly: scale, opacity and blur cleanly map recency to proximity in a believable z-axis
Restrained monochrome palette with a single blue accent keeps the 3D field calm and lets glow halos do the spatial work
Typographic hierarchy inside cards is tight — bold title, soft body, muted timestamp form a clean repeating module
dominant_weaknesses: Connection 'threads' are nearly invisible — the core brief promise of linked thought is barely expressed beyond two faint diagonals
Toolbar card competes with content: same fill, same radius, same weight as notes, so it reads as another floating thought, not chrome
Ancient/Recent axis label is rotated awkwardly and clipped at the edge, undermining the otherwise confident spatial system
fix_priorities: Make thread connections first-class: glowing bezier strands with directionality, varying opacity by relationship strength
Differentiate the input panel from notes via material, border, or pinning so it feels like UI, not memory
Reposition and restyle the time axis as a subtle gradient rail with clear endpoint labels
Introduce parallax/drift motion cues (even static hints like motion blur trails) to sell the floating metaphor
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral spatial poetry leads, reflective concept is strong, but behavioral clarity lags because connections and controls are under-expressed.
rationale.intent_fit: It convincingly stages recency-as-depth but underdelivers on the 'connections are threads' half of the brief.
